cost: Fixed-scale scalar O(n^2), presupposition O(B+n^3), maxims O(n^2), excluding string-byte costs; no measured speed claim.
description: Ordered scalar, presupposition and maxim inferences over supplied dependency Words; bounds-safe malformed ancestry and distinct event coordinates.
forward: Scalar candidates are suppressed by stronger words, negation and cancellation; duplicate trigger/strongest results collapse.
Presuppositions select triggers and first complements, project bounded clause ancestry, and license against last 50 prior tokens.
Maxims emit question then exclamation then event order; main chains these APIs before appending current words to history.
inverse: Behavior complement excludes blocked scalar emissions, licensing supported only beyond the 50-token window and invalid/reflexive manner edges.
Reverse fibers retain all compatible word graphs, histories and sentence punctuation; omitted words, older histories and provenance are unrecoverable.
limitations: Finite supplied-input fixtures, partial syntax and source-inspected callers; no linguistic truth proof.
Scalar substring cancellation, duplicate surface triggers, first complement selection and punctuation heuristics retain legacy semantics.
No learned model, parser, teacher, GPU or live corpus execution; no automatic approximation substitution.
state: Read-only supplied Word/history/text inputs. Valid dependency semantics are external; presupposition licensing records lexical support, not truth.
